submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 3.25 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation performance among all tested configurations. The systematic optimization study revealed that R3 achieves a maximum separation of 4.749 sigma at 3.25 cm thickness, significantly outperforming R1 (best: 3.8σ at 3 cm) and R2 (best: 2.9σ at 3 cm). The separation performance shows a clear peak around 3.25 cm for R3, with values of 4.579σ at 2.5 cm, 4.749σ at 3.25 cm, and 4.624σ at 3.5 cm, confirming this is near the optimal thickness. R3 passes all hard constraints including the critical aging requirement, ensuring long-term operational reliability without replacement during the 10-year run.
